heading: Tags
intro: A tag a writer types for the first time waits here. Readers see it only after you approve it. Give it a name in every interface language, so each reader sees it in theirs. Reject a tag that breaks the rules or repeats another: it leaves every story and the writers are told. Every decision is in the audit log.

empty.waiting: No tag is waiting. New tags appear here as writers add them.
empty.missing: Every tag has a name in every interface language.

reasonHint: For the audit log. Writers are told the tag was not approved, never the reason.

problems.taken: Another tag already has this name in this language.

outcomes.rejected: Rejected. It left every story and the writers were told.

failures.not_allowed: Only the moderation team can decide on tags.
failures.unreachable: We couldn’t reach the server. Try again.
failures.not_found: This tag was already decided. The list is up to date now.
failures.invalid: Fix the fields shown and try again.
